reason: I pay €12 a m² for film and tape done by my own people, and that costs me about €442 a year. €19 a m² plus a 150 m² minimum and a 50% deposit is a lot to ask on my small jobs for something I already solve.
objection: It is more than 50% dearer than what I do now, on tiny volumes, and I have never had a callback bill big enough to justify it.
instead: Keep using self-adhesive film and tape with my own labour, and be more careful on site.
would_change_my_mind: A reference from a premium block that showed fewer glazing and frame damage claims, plus a price near €12 a m² all-in with no 150 m² minimum.
